etsy.title: ADHD Tax Sticker, Funny Receipt Vinyl Decal, Forgetful Late Fee Humor, Neurodivergent Gift
etsy.description:
An adhd tax sticker that totals up your late fees, forgotten subscriptions, sad vegetables, and the charger you had to buy again. You will lose this receipt.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, planner, or desk. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: One ADHD tax sticker on Etsy shows illustrations of a bill, alarm clock, grocery bag, and brain with 'OVERDUE' stamp. Our receipt format with itemized line items is a distinct design.
Most ADHD stickers are $3-$7 for singles; multi-packs run up to $20. Common themes are side quests, too many tabs, squirrel distractions, and hyperfocus.
Amazon ADHD sticker packs (10-50 pcs) dominate at $5-$15. Singles are rare. Common phrases: 'Powered by ADHD', 'Too Many Tabs Open', 'Highway to Squirrel'.

research.notes: "adhd tax" has its own Etsy market page, making it a strong specific keyword. The receipt format differentiates this sticker from the stamp/overdue designs competitors use.
